blocks.html: In harmony with the general purposes and content of this Resolution and the general purposes of the Special Gowanus Mixed Use District, the regulations of this Chapter shall apply within the Special Gowanus Mixed Use District. The regulations of all other Chapters of this Resolution are applicable, except as modified, supplemented or superseded by the provisions of this Chapter. In the event of a conflict between the provisions of this Chapter and other regulations of this Resolution, the provisions of this Chapter shall control.
